settings.hero_desc: A detailed miniature racing helmet finished in glossy black with your event branding, presented in a clear case on a sleek base. A standout giveaway and keepsake for motorsport events, launches and fan experiences.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your event/team branding, helmet colours and base
settings.s1_body: Few things say motorsport like a racing helmet. We recreate it in miniature, finished in a deep gloss with your event or team branding, and present it in a clear case on a clean base. Produced in quantity, it makes a premium giveaway and lasting keepsake for car shows, race events, sponsor activations and fan experiences.
settings.case_body: Produced as branded miniatures for a motorsport festival, these helmets became the event's most-wanted giveaway - cased, branded and genuinely kept on desks long after the weekend.
settings.case_quote: There were multiple items in the gift box but this racing helmet was loved by everyone. Client wanted 10 qty but they ended up ordering an extra piece to keep on their own desk.
settings.prov_p: The Racing helmet is the ultimate symbol of racing. As a branded miniature, it carries that excitement - and your name - far longer than any flyer or lanyard.
